risks.title: Mastery theater
risks.trigger: Mastery rises from completion or repeated identical items.
risks.mitigation: Require visible unassisted, delayed, and transfer evidence; block G5.

risks.title: Wrong graph granularity
risks.trigger: One node hides distinct errors or adjacent nodes never differ in evidence/remediation.
risks.mitigation: Version the graph hypothesis; split with new IDs after evidence and never repurpose IDs.

risks.title: Stale Rust or library guidance
risks.trigger: Toolchain/source is older than the freshness window or compiler behavior changes.
risks.mitigation: Pin releases, run quarterly review, and retain golden compiler fixtures.

risks.title: Copyright or license breach
risks.trigger: Content lacks provenance/use decision or copies incompatible material.
risks.mitigation: Original/link-only default, mandatory license audit; block G7/G9.

risks.title: Native runner escape or overclaim
risks.trigger: Untrusted code reaches host resources or native execution is called isolated.
risks.mitigation: Curated manifests, strict limits, honest warning, no hostile/multi-user exposure; block G4.

risks.title: Hostile website reaches localhost
risks.trigger: Origin, host, token, or custom-header enforcement can be bypassed.
risks.mitigation: Same-origin production, exact checks, safe GETs, and adversarial tests.

risks.title: Migration, import, or reset loses history
risks.trigger: A migration/import partially applies or recovery requires silent reset.
risks.mitigation: Backup, staged validation, transaction, integrity and restore drills; block G3/G9.

risks.title: Multi-skill blame
risks.trigger: One item failure downgrades unrelated outcomes.
risks.mitigation: Primary/supporting mappings and rubric-step evidence; no blanket tag update.

risks.title: Variant inequivalence
risks.trigger: Seeded forms differ materially in difficulty or required skills.
risks.mitigation: Fixed seeds, versioned forms, human review, split inequivalent variants.

risks.title: Hint clicking or harmful help avoidance
risks.trigger: Hints become passive reveals or the UI rewards remaining stuck.
risks.mitigation: Require a small action between levels, allow bypass, and schedule fresh proof after reveal.

risks.title: Review overload
risks.trigger: Due work exceeds the daily cap or hides overflow.
risks.mitigation: Daily cap, visible overflow, goal horizon, transparent intervals.

risks.title: Premature interleaving
risks.trigger: Confusable topics are mixed before initial acquisition readiness.
risks.mitigation: Block initial instruction; interleave reviewed siblings only after readiness.

risks.title: Editor or graph excludes assistive technology
risks.trigger: Core information/actions require pointer, color, canvas, or inaccessible Monaco behavior.
risks.mitigation: Textarea/list/tree alternatives and manual assistive-tech gate; block G8.

risks.title: Offline claim hides network requests
risks.trigger: Runtime fetches unbundled assets, analytics, or remote content.
risks.mitigation: Bundle assets, CSP, and runtime network test; block G8.

risks.title: Architecture bloat delays learning proof
risks.trigger: New service, crate, store, or infrastructure lacks a demonstrated boundary.
risks.mitigation: One SPA/service/crate/SQLite path and Ponytail review.

risks.title: Content volume overwhelms quality
risks.trigger: Breadth grows before the golden slice and validators pass.
risks.mitigation: Golden slice, templates, coverage, source and technical review.

risks.title: LLM dependency enters tutoring
risks.trigger: Runtime tutoring or mastery depends on nondeterministic model output.
risks.mitigation: Deterministic core, authored hints, official-doc workflow; LLM cannot award mastery.

risks.title: Gamification replaces learning
risks.trigger: Streak/points affect recommendation or mastery.
risks.mitigation: Optimize delayed transfer and recurrence; keep streak informational only.

risks.title: Confidence mistaken for competence
risks.trigger: Confidence edits after feedback or directly changes mastery.
risks.mitigation: Commit before feedback, store separately, calibrate only with sufficient evidence.

risks.title: Dependency or runtime compromise
risks.trigger: Unpinned/unreviewed dependency or evaluator artifact enters release.
risks.mitigation: Lockfiles, audits, SBOM, pinned reviewed releases and residual-risk record.

risks.title: Source prompt injection
risks.trigger: Embedded source instructions influence tools or promotion.
risks.mitigation: Treat raw as untrusted, never execute commands, hash/license and human review; block GW1/GF2.

risks.title: Visualizer inference becomes truth
risks.trigger: Generated link/edge is imported without typed rationale and provenance.
risks.mitigation: Quarantine inference and require typed reviewed promotion; block GF2.

risks.title: Parity scope drifts into proprietary content
risks.trigger: A stage copies app/paid/community/unlicensed material.
risks.mitigation: Pin/audit definitions, preserve notices, independently author tests; block G11.

risks.title: Workbench broadens host access
risks.trigger: Arbitrary roots, methods, terminal, extensions, or AI edits become reachable.
risks.mitigation: Curated roots, method allowlist, bounded lifecycle, adversarial E06 tests.

risks.title: Course volume becomes endless prerequisite
risks.trigger: Platform release waits for all content or quality gates weaken for calendar reasons.
risks.mitigation: Separate platform/core/catalog gates, mastery skips, one-stage WIP, required/elective labels.
